about: Short text messages for the lesson lm-naive-bayes, written by the course: 40 to train on and 20 to test on, each a label, spam or ok, and its text. The texts are in lower case without punctuation, so that splitting a text at its spaces gives its words. No message holds a real name, number, address or link.
